text:
Priya S.: heads-up, opened a compacting PR that trims repeated long examples and unblocks the structured-output migration: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4789. need a quick sanity pass on SDK snippets (py/js/go) and the nullable examples.
Evan M.: on it. which files are you collapsing? i've been finding people link to the old long_examples page from the SDK guides.
Priya S.: moving long_examples.md to examples/expanded/long_examples.md and leaving a small canonical page at guides/structured-output/index.md. adding redirect anchors on the old page so links don't 404.
Kai T.: small nit: the Hugo renderer is choking on indented fenced blocks in index.md. please remove leading 2-space indentation from all triple-backtick blocks.
Priya S.: noted. i also standardized the sample envelope to the action-response format. sample included in the PR:```json
{
  "action": "lookup_account",
  "args": { "account_id": "acc_42" },
  "response": { "status": "not_found", "payload": null }
}
```
Evan M.: that looks good. for JS SDK snippet, prefer client.callAction('lookup_account', {account_id}) over client.invoke, will update examples.
Kai T.: the Go SDK has slightly different error semantics; i'll add a small migration note under /guides/migration so folks know how to map the response envelope to Go idioms.
doc-bot: link-checker: 8 broken links detected in docs/guides/structured-output (CI job #982).
Priya S.: thanks bot. Evan, can you run a quick grep for "invoke(" and submit a follow-up PR with replacements where callAction exists? we should avoid mass-replacing where older SDKs only have invoke.
Evan M.: will do. also found 2 examples that used "payload": {} to mean empty; i changed them to payload: null and added a short sentence explaining nullable payloads are allowed for 204-like responses.
Kai T.: please add a single-line backcompat blurb: "If your SDK version predates callAction, continue to use invoke and consult /guides/migration for mapping."
Priya S.: added reviewers @Evan M. and @Kai T. on PR 4789. blockers before merge: markdown-lint green, redirects in place, and CI link-check passing.
Evan M.: ran markdown-lint locally, fixed frontmatter spacing and a stray tab. pushed edits.
Kai T.: LGTM from my side after doc tweaks. i'll watch CI.
doc-bot: docs-build: preview available at https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-4789. link-checker now reports 0 failures.
Priya S.: merged—thanks everyone :tada:
Evan M.: sweet. i also added a tiny test snippet in examples/expanded to show an edgecase with union payload types.
Priya S.: perfect. follow-up: i'll schedule a short retro to capture lessons for next migration (avoid large monolithic example pages).
